text:
Jamie: Quick sync — planning a small traffic nudge on EU edge tonight to validate the new routing-policy fallback. Target window 22:00-22:30 UTC. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks? :eyes:
Sara: I can kick off the rollout and monitor logs. Will need someone to run curl checks from EU regions.
Chen: I can run the active smoke probes (FR/DE/IE). What's the exact policy change?
Jamie: We'll change policy from weight 100 -> 85 on primary pool, and add 15 to the canary pool with shorter TTL. No code changes, just routing config. Plan: 1) deploy policy, 2) validate health, 3) ramp to 30% if green.
Priya: FYI — console shows a pending model-build job at 21:50; recommend waiting until that's done or confirm it's unrelated.
Luca: That model-build shouldn't touch serving infra, but good call. If it runs longer than 21:55, let's slip by 10m.
Sara: I'll aim for 22:10 then. Preflight checklist for me: config diff, rollback key, health endpoints, alert channels.
Jamie: Rollback plan: revert weights to 100/0, TTL back to 300s. If any 5xx spike > 0.5% for 5m or p50 latency +45% for 3m, rollback.
Chen: I'll run these checks after deploy: `curl -sS -D - https://edge-eu.example.com/health` and `curl -sS https://edge-eu.example.com/ping -H 'x-test: routing-tilt'`
Priya: Add a KV-cache priming step for the canary pool if we see cold-cache errors.
Sara: Noted. I'll post results in-thread with short logs. If ok, I'll bump to 30% after 10m observation.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-03-17 22:10 UTC — eng-platform. Reminder DM will go out 15m before.
Luca: Can we set the DNS TTL to 60s for the maintenance window? Helps quick rollbacks.
Jamie: Yes, set TTL=60s. Make sure the route-propagation probes are green before we start traffic.
Chen: Running probes now -> all green from EU probes. Screenshot pasted (omitted).
Sara: Starting deploy at 22:10 UTC. I'll paste the policy diff and current canary weights as soon as it's up. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll watch logs for model-serving errors and KV timeouts.
Jamie: Thanks team. If any red flags, call rollback and ping #oncall. Otherwise we'll follow the ramp plan.
Sara: Deploy done. Initial 15% applied at 22:11. Sample diff:
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "edge-tilt",
  "primary_pool": { "weight": 85 },
  "canary_pool": { "weight": 15, "ttl": 60 }
}
```
Chen: Health check results at 22:12: 200/200 from FR/DE/IE, p50 stable. No 5xx.
Priya: Logs look clean. No KV thrash.
Luca: DNS TTL applied 60s. Propagation ok.
Sara: Bumping to 30% at 22:21. Observing for 10m.
Chen: Monitoring — latency +10% but within SLO. Nothing alarming.
Jamie: If all continues, we'll call this a successful nudge and close the window. Great work. :tada:
